The Wall

Every quoted line in the book, at a glance. Down the wall, the eleven parts of the story in order; across it, the peoples whose records tell it. Each square is one people telling one part, sized by how many of its lines say so. Click a square to read the lines. Click a part's name to read that part of the story. Click a people to see everything it tells.

The wall Figures across the story

The figures that appear in more than one part of the story, in the order of the story. A dot is a part where the figure is named. Click a figure for its names in every tongue, who equated them, and its lines.
